title: Add M12 performance pass: bring level 9 ultra-quality cold sim into AC-3 budget
description:
## M12 — Performance Pass (level 9 ultra → AC-3 budget)

Per .design/realistic-planet-generator.md REQ-3 + AC-3, milestone definition. Builds on M0-M11 (main HEAD `aa863d5`). Last milestone before v1 ship-ready.

### In scope

1. **Profile current pipeline at level 8 + level 9** — identify hot loops in CPU-side bridge code.

2. **Erosion kernel optimization** — tile-based with shared memory for the Laplacian could double speed (per design.md §8 priority #1).

3. **Flow accumulation perf** — already GPU per M3 (Braun-Willett). Profile and tune.

4. **Climate iteration** — reduce iteration count via better initial guess (use prior-step steady-state, not fresh init).

5. **Snapshot streaming** — at level 9, snapshot reads chunk over multiple frames per AC-11 (was deferred). Implement chunked snapshot with backpressure.

6. **GPU buffer compression** — for fields with bounded range, use f16 instead of f32. Halves memory for those.

7. **Tests** — perf regression at level 8, snapshot chunking 60fps smoke, f16 accuracy within ε.

### Out of scope (do not start)
- New features.
- VTT exports.

### Acceptance criteria for M12
- [ ] Level 9 ultra cold sim measurable improvement vs pre-M12 baseline.
- [ ] Snapshot chunking implemented for level 9+; 60fps maintained per AC-13.
- [ ] M0-M11 tests still pass.
- [ ] npm test + tsc --noEmit both pass.
- [ ] No stubs / TODOs.

### Lesson from M0-M11
**Commit each optimization separately, run tsc between commits.** M11 nailed this with 8 clean commits. M12 has 5-6 natural commit groups.

### References
- .design/realistic-planet-generator.md REQ-3 / AC-3 / AC-11 / AC-13
- design.md §8 (optimization priorities)
